searchText: About EIP-4803: Limit transaction gas to a maximum of 2^63-1. During the last ACD call I mistakenly said that it's a no-change in Erigon & geth. Actually, currently in both geth & Erigon 2^63-1 is the maximum allowed *block* gas limit, not transaction gas limit. So technically EIP-4803 probably entails a code change. In any case, it makes total sense to me to do it. **ACD in 30 minutes!** Agenda & stream linked above. Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/91348592283?pwd=SnRnL1VTeXNYVE9CaWpBbnJEUXhQZz09 Didn't mention it on the call directly, but for North American attendees, note that DST will happen prior to the next call and so your local time for the call will change ⏰
